claim: Blood almost never hangs one wall sprite over another: its town maps have 0 to 3.3 clashing pairs per 100 wall sprites (E2M1, E6M1, E4M9, E3M1) and its busiest 6.7 to 8.0 (E1M1, E3M2, DWE3M1, DWE3M10), with 0 to 4 fully hidden. Things may sit beside or above one another on a wall, never on the same spot.
evidence: tools/mine_wall_sprites.py; Gravesend before the fix: 18.86 pairs per 100 and 26 fully hidden
the owner (bloodmap/wallplane.py docstring): 'they can be next to each other or on the top of each other, but not on the same place'
use: Hang through a wall-plane occupancy that reserves each sprite's drawn rectangle (along and down), then run tools.sprite_fit.
